title: Bardic Lore
description: You've studied a variety of arcane subjects, including:
pick: A Bestiary of Creatures Most Unusual
Grand Histories of the Known World

outcomes.text:
Mark **one** as active when you choose this Move. You can ask the GM questions about your active subject times per session equal to your int; the GM will answer truthfully.

When you **Make Camp**, you can spend some time studying and/or remembering your training to change your active subject.

title: A Kind of Magic
description: You can **Cast a Spell** + int by combining a verb and a substance from the Wizard's **Enchantment** or **Illusion** Schools.  If you could already use these Schools, work with the GM to create a new verb for each redundant School

outcomes.text: To Cast a Spell you need to do a performance. Your unique 7-9 option is:
bullets: *Your magic is drained*; forget one of the Schools of Magic you have access to until you next **Make Camp**

outcomes.text: Modify Emotions;Temporarily Charm, ___denex___ (if you already had Enchantment)
Cloak; Disguise, ___dilex___ (if you already had Illusion)

title: A Knave, a Rascal
description: You get access to the following Roguish Skills:

outcomes.text: When you **Defy Danger** or **Sneak Past** using one of your Roguish Skills, you may roll+INT (instead of another Stat).

submoves.title: Note
submoves.description: If you already had any of these Roguish Skills, work with the GM to create a new one for each redundant Skill.

title: Virtuoso's Mind
description: You can have up to two Bardic Lore subjects active at a time. When you ask the GM a question about an active subject, instead of them answering you may choose to **Spout Lore** with **adv**. On a 12+, you may answer (instead of the GM).
